name: Navahondilla (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically into three stripes of green, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Navahondilla (a castle on red and a bull).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 3 August 2000 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 186 of 25 September 2000); the flag is square, green, white and yellow in vertical stripes, with the arms of Navahondilla at the centre.
